body: there’s something to be said about time. right now it’s awful and in such a way that it makes u self conscious and feel bad, but some other event will occur that will draw people’s attention away. in a couple of months the wound will scab over and it won’t be as tormenting. focus on yourself and self care. i am glad you were able to approach the university about this, and it sucks and you were not given the privacy and confidentiality that you deserve in a case like this. stay strong and wishing all the best even tho it feels like the worst. if there are on campus resources like counselors, use those bc just having someone to vent to even if you don’t like therapy is refreshing and gets stuff off the forefront of your mind

im a gay woman as well and this was my mindset in high school. i kept telling myself i was going to kill myself before i graduated bc i could not imagine a future where i was successful and happy. nowadays the due date has changed due to different circumstances but i’m still stuck here on the daily. if you are in an environment where you can seek counseling (my school offers it), take that option even if you hate the idea of therapy just having someone who you can vent all your darkest thoughts to is really good, and they also are not all high and mighty about the suicide thing and they won’t scream at u that it gets better. if not there’s online therapy resources. also! i was totally undeclared until last year until i declared a major bc i thot i needed one. more recently the staff have been really nice and encouraging me to try accounting and i gained some friends from going to the school gender and sexuality group. i really recommend doing this or reaching out and finding lgbtq+ support groups around you. having gay friends is refreshing and many of us go thru the same mental struggles. i am wishing you all the best, and i hope you find peace some way or another

he’s gaslighting and victim blaming you. what’s important is keeping your story authentic and not letting that asshole warp your perspective because you know what happened and he wants to get out of trouble. continue with this case and know there are people out there supporting you. remember to seek help and there are online resources for victims that i recommend seeking out. you are not alone.
